name: smwpatches-title-screen-solution
title: Title Screen Solution
description:
This patch will allow Mario to die on the title screen, without weird bugs happening. It includes two patches:

Hurt.asm - Acts like the knock-back patch.
Reset.asm - Will reset the title screen when you die.

Tester's note: Simple but quite handy! It is now completely fine to die on the title-screen in whatever way can be imagined.
